stage0066_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Fools who invoke a god's name falsely...」

stage0066_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「What irony, to be ordered to purge them.
　All units, begin the attack.」

stage0066_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Now then, come out, you believers.」

stage0066_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Geminis...!
　Why attack us, when we've allied
　with Amalgam!」

stage0066_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「So you're the commander...」

stage0066_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Answer me!
　Depending on your answer, this won't end lightly!」

stage0066_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Don't make me laugh.
　Then show me just what
　'not going lightly' means.」

stage0066_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I don't know.
　But it works in our favor.」

stage0066_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「The Ptolemy will be here soon too.
　Let's pull back too.」

stage0066_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Doesn't look like a falling-out, does it.」

stage0066_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It seems Geminis has allied with Amalgam,
　while standing against $$マーティアル$$.」

stage0066_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ラッセ$$
「Those who'd have Earthlings wipe each other
　out, yet deny a god of war...」

stage0066_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ミレイナ$$
「We've got Seiei and the others aboard, desu!」

stage0066_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, launch!
　We can't afford to leave Geminis
　or $$マーティアル$$ unchecked.」

stage0066_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Perfect timing, so $c showed up too.
　However strong they may be, spreading
　their forces thin limits what they can do.」

stage0066_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「No need to mobilize the main force.
　I'll finish you off here, along with $$マーティアル$$.」

stage0066_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Tch...!
　Was it a mistake to send the Amalgam
　forces to intercept $$ミスリル$$?」

stage0066_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Attention, all units.
　This will likely become a three-way fight.」

stage0066_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「But there's the future to think of.
　At least, we'll take out both commanders.」

stage0066_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$キリコ$$
（$$テイタニア$$...
　You're going to tell me where $$フィアナ$$ is.）

stage0066_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Sagara, do you know where that man's
　strength comes from?」

stage0066_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「That answer's worth fifty points.
　Then there's no point in your infiltration.」

stage0066_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$スズネ$$
「What's wrong, $n?
　You look so serious...」

stage0066_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$デュオ$$
「That's the guy called $$アドヴェント$$...!」

stage0066_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「That man... siding with Geminis to crush us?!」

stage0066_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$n
「Wait, please.
　That person came to lend us a hand, I hear.」

stage0066_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$スザク$$
「He helped us inside the Temple, but...」

stage0066_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I've told $n about my situation.
　First, let's repel Geminis」

stage0066_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I'll back you up, $n」

stage0066_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「The one who got in our way at Orb...!」

stage0066_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「$$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$,
　thinking it'll all go your way is a grave mistake」

stage0066_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「And I'll teach you the error
　of thinking all of Chrono
　has bowed to you」

stage0066_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, work with $$アドヴェント$$
　to attack Geminis and $$マーティアル$$.」

stage0066_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「If we try to exploit this situation,
　we could end up caught in a pincer.
　Don't forget that.」

stage0066_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「$n!
　I'm leaving you to keep watch on him!」

stage0066_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Now, let's go, $n...!
　Protect humanity's history with your own hands!」

stage0066_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$フェルト$$
「Neither $$マーティアル$$ nor Geminis has reinforcements.」

stage0066_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Amalgam's forces didn't show up, did they.」

stage0066_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$テッサ$$
「They seem to have gone to intercept $$ミスリル$$.
　If we don't hurry, they'll turn back.」

stage0066_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「No need to worry about that.」

stage0066_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Well done, everyone.
　How did it go?」

stage0066_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
Soldier
「We've broken a section of Amalgam's
　encirclement. We can escape that way.」

stage0066_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
Soldier
「With their base destroyed and the
　encirclement broken, the Amalgam-$$マーティアル$$
　alliance should withdraw from $$ヘルマジスタン$$.」

stage0066_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「We were on the back foot until now,
　but we managed to even the score.」

stage0066_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「All units, prepare to fall back.
　In my place, please escort $c
　to the border.」

stage0066_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Before that, I want to hear about
　you and Chrono.」

stage0066_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「...Unfortunately, there's no time.
　Escaping $$ヘルマジスタン$$ comes first,
　and then I must go to space.」

stage0066_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's right.
　To gather data to break the Prison of Time.」

stage0066_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「As for our innocence, ask $n about it.
　When your memory-seal breaks, the real fight begins.」

stage0066_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Just $$アドヴェント$$ is fine.」

stage0066_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$n
「...What do you know about the angel...?」

stage0066_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's my archenemy... my fate, you might say.」

stage0066_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Being able to help you is my pleasure.
　Until we meet again!」

stage0066_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Refreshing, and warm...
　Like someone made from May sunshine.」

stage0066_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「What do you make of it, $$刹那$$?」

stage0066_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$刹那$$
「He doesn't seem like a man with a hidden agenda...」

stage0066_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「But there's too much about Chrono that's unclear.
　Trusting him too much would be dangerous.」

stage0066_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$カレン$$
「Maybe he's after $$ガドライト$$ too,
　same as you.」

stage0066_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
Soldier
「Let's go, everyone.
　We'll escort you to the border.」

stage0066_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Thank you.
　...All units, withdraw following Chrono's lead.」

stage0066_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$デュオ$$
「So once we're clear of $$ヘルマジスタン$$,
　what's next?」

stage0066_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$カレン$$
「Obviously.
　We're headed for the holy land of $$アレギウム$$.」

stage0066_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$宗介$$
「A private channel?
　Who would contact me now, of all times...」

stage0066_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
???
「Pleased to meet you, Sergeant Sousuke Sagara.
　It's a shame I won't get to see you
　activate the Lambda Driver.」

stage0066_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
???
「I'm not someone worth naming.
　Though you're beneath even that, I'd wager.」

stage0066_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
???
「Take it that way if you like.
　Call it a declaration of war, even.」

stage0066_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
???
「Goodbye.
　You really aren't fit for it, after all.」

stage0066_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$宗介$$
（Knowing about the Lambda Driver means
　he's with Amalgam, then...）

stage0066_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$宗介$$
（I don't have time to indulge provocations right now...）

stage0066_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Damn it!
　I can't face the captain like this!」

stage0066_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I won't let you get away...!」

stage0066_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「If you don't want to die, step out
　of your machine.」

stage0066_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「You...!
　You want me to bear a captive's shame?!」

stage0066_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I don't want to do this either.
　But if I must...」

stage0066_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Yo... long time, Imitation Boy.
　But I've got no business with you today.」

stage0066_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$...!」

stage0066_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Get away from $$アンナロッタ$$, bud.
　She's our hope.」

stage0066_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「How absurd, $$ガドライト$$.
　You wrapped the Earth in despair, and yet
　you'd speak the beautiful word 'hope'?」

stage0066_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「...I'm not reckless enough to face down
　a $$スフィア・リアクター$$ in its Third Stage.」

stage0066_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Seems you understand a little.」

stage0066_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I'll tell the Imitation Boy over there too:
　don't get any funny ideas.」

stage0066_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「This $$ジェミニア$$ is mine... the Geminaids'.」

stage0066_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「...$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$...」

stage0066_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$n
「Am I... are we no match for him...?」

stage0066_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「For now, that may be so.」

stage0066_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「But tomorrow... the future is unknown.
　That's why $n... you must keep fighting.」

stage0066_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Tch!
　I let my guard down!」

stage0066_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「...A promise, $$キリコ$$.
　I'll tell you where she is!」

stage0066_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「She's being held at the $$マーティアル$$ Order's headquarters!」

stage0066_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「So it's the holy land, $$アレギウム$$...!」

stage0066_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「I'll be waiting, $$キリコ$$!
　I'll settle things with you there!」

stage0066_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$カレン$$
「The holy land, $$アレギウム$$...
　That's where $$フィアナ$$ is, isn't it.」

stage0066_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Alright!
　If they wear each other down like this,
　it makes things easier on us!」

stage0066_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$マオ$$
「What you say makes sense, but it's kind of pathetic.」

stage0066_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（$$マーティアル$$ and Geminis...
　Why are they at odds...?）

stage0066_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（Aren't both sides, with Amalgam
　as intermediary, working together...?）

stage0066_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Seems you've improved since before, $n.」

stage0066_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「You can surpass that $$ガドライト$$, I know it!
　Now, go!」

stage0066_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「So the Imitation's teamed up with our nuisance!」

stage0066_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I won't allow him to be called the Imitation.
　He's the one man who holds the potential
　to surpass $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$ himself.」

stage0066_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Let's go, $n!
　Beating her is our declaration of war
　against $$ガドライト$$!」

stage0066_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「The 'Untouchable', $$キリコ・キュービィー$$...!
　Your very existence is unforgivable!」

stage0066_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Knowing won't help you.
　She's already beyond your reach.」

stage0066_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I'll ask once more.
　Where's $$フィアナ$$?」

stage0066_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「If you can defeat me, I'll tell you...!
　Meaning you'll never learn where she is!」

stage0066_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「I'll dedicate your death to my father!
　That's the meaning of my existence!」

stage0066_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$マオ$$ told me all about you!
　So you're the one who took $$フィアナ$$!」

stage0066_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Not bad at all!
　But don't think you can beat
　a 《$$ネクスタント$$》 like me!」

stage0066_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$カレン$$
「I'm not the one who'll beat you...!
　It's $$キリコ$$!」

stage0066_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$カレン$$
「But anyone who torments my friend
　is getting a taste of pain from me!」

stage0066_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「This man...!
　Compared to before, I can't feel
　any fighting spirit from him at all!」

stage0066_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Seems I overestimated him...!
　I've no business with small fry!
　Stay out of my way!」

stage0066_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Tough, unshakeable resolve...!
　Is he another warrior of the same
　breed as $$キリコ・キュービィー$$?!」

stage0066_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Neither he nor I are anywhere near calm.
　You'll learn that for yourself someday.」

stage0066_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「An unfortunate man, you are.」

stage0066_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「You'll come to know despair someday.
　When your existence seals this
　planet's future shut...!」

stage0066_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「If you'd escape that fate,
　then let me cut you down here!」

stage0066_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「So you're the one who's been sneaking
　around, sniffing out our secrets...!」

stage0066_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Before you speak of me,
　be ashamed of your own sneaking
　about, you cowards.」

stage0066_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Are you trying to insult us?!」

stage0066_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Flying into a rage over this much,
　you must be truly ashamed of yourselves.」

stage0066_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「You...!
　Do you want to anger me that badly?!」

stage0066_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Let me tell you, Geminis!
　You're the ones who angered me first!」

stage0066_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「The negotiator from Paradigm City...!」

stage0066_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Miss $$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$, was it...
　I've wanted a word with you too.」

stage0066_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Going to beg for your life with
　that famed negotiating skill of yours?」

stage0066_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Not quite.
　...You look to be a trained group of
　soldiers. I want to know your background.」

stage0066_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「If I knew that, I might make some
　sense of your otherwise senseless acts.」

stage0066_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「You call our fight senseless...!」

stage0066_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Naturally.
　I see no real reason behind your
　attacks on this planet.」

stage0066_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「If it's just to kill time, as
　$$ガドライト$$ says, I despise you
　from the bottom of my heart.」

stage0066_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Flying into a rage and turning to violence?」

stage0066_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「A shame...!
　Our mentalities are truly
　irreconcilable, it seems!」

stage0066_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Do you even know what it is
　you worship?」

stage0066_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「You...!
　Mocking $$マーティアル$$'s god, are you?!」

stage0066_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Never mind.
　What you believe is no concern
　of mine.」

stage0066_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
（But since it's him,
　you'll all face despair eventually...）
